A.title: A · one counter fact
A.how: One fact holds the count. Each agent reads it (fact get), adds one, and writes it back (fact update) — the way a shared counter row works in a DIY store.
seed: Kesswick Labs Tamsor seats: 12 of 20 in use.
A.write: Kesswick Labs Tamsor seats: {n} of 20 in use (last assigned: {name} by {agent}).

B.title: B · one record per assignment, the seat as subject
B.how: Each agent adds its own record (fact add); the app knows the pool (20 seats, 12 in use before today) and counts the records. The record names the seat: “Tamsor seat assigned to …”.

C.title: C · one record per assignment, the person as subject
C.how: Each agent adds its own record (fact add); the app knows the pool (20 seats, 12 in use before today) and counts the records. The record names the person who holds a seat.
C.write: {name} ({email}) holds one of Kesswick Labs' 20 Tamsor seats; assigned by {agent} on 2026-10-19.
C.query: holds one of Kesswick Labs' 20 Tamsor seats
